parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotence token. Ensures that repeated requests do not result in duplicate operations.

parameters.name: Lsn
parameters.description: The LSN for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or SnapshotTimestamp. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified LSN.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to perform the operation.

parameters.name: SnapshotTimestamp
parameters.description: The point in time for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or Lsn. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified point in time.
